arm_a.answer: If an exception occurs, Flask still runs teardown. Flask.wsgi_app always calls ctx.pop(...) in its finally path, and AppContext.pop invokes do_teardown_request and do_teardown_appcontext. In current Flask, both teardown methods wrap each callback in a _CollectErrors helper and only raise after iterating all callbacks and signals, so teardown does not stop at the first callback failure. That means all registered teardown callbacks are attempted, even when request processing raised an exception, and any teardown errors are aggregated afterward.
